notes.title: Progress on the New Game: Fun with Ragdolls Plus
notes.content:
[h2]The Name of the New Game[/h2]
Hello everyone! I’m thrilled to finally announce the name of my upcoming game…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/3205df0093e64d26f735d7c90e236683b8a88f88.png[/img]

Let me assure you, the word “Plus” does not mean there's a subscription service attached to it. It simply represents the incredible new features, enhancements, and content that we've been working on for the past few months and months to come.

[h2]The Team Behind the Game[/h2]
This game is by far the biggest and most ambitious project I’ve ever created in my life. I want to give a huge thank you to everyone who supported me by buying the last game. It's because of your support that I have been able to bring on a team of three incredibly talented people to work on this new game. I now have a concept artist, animator, and music composer. They are the most talented people I know, and I’m so grateful to have them on board.

[h2]Get Ready for the Most Epic Soundtrack Ever[/h2]
Speaking of music, I recently received a preview of the theme music, and let me tell you, I literally jumped up and down in excitement! Petteri Sainio, who scored the previous game and Fun with Ragdolls 5, is doing an absolutely incredible job on this upcoming game. You have no idea what you're in for because with the incredible work he's doing, it’s  going to be a blockbuster-level musical experience!

[url=https://soundcloud.com/petterisainiocomposer/fun-with-ragdolls-5-official-score?utm_source=clipboard&utm_medium=text&utm_campaign=social_sharing]Take a listen to some of his music if you haven’t already![/url]

[h2]The Fun with Ragdolls World Expands with a New Story[/h2]
But that's not all! One of the biggest additions to this new game is the story mode. I’ll be expanding on the story of the Fun with Ragdolls world, following Dummy Danny and his adventures. In fact, the script for the story was originally written three years ago (in 2020) for a movie. While I consider myself a filmmaker at heart, I came to the conclusion that the story would be best adapted as a playable experience in this new game.

[h2]Fun with Ragdolls Plus and Beyond[/h2]
In terms of actual game development, I’m building all the systems to be extendable, reusable, and efficient! This game is a stepping stone for future projects because it will allow me to reuse the majority of the code. The utilities namespace is huge! By creating reusable systems, I'm setting the foundation for an ecosystem that will continue to evolve and expand.

Additionally, I would like to share these systems and tools through GitHub to help other game developers using the Unity game engine to speed up their workflow. However, I want to ensure that these systems are polished and well-documented before making them publicly available. This would more than likely be post-launch since it will have been battle-tested with my own game.

[h2]A New Website and Stuff for Creators[/h2]
I'm also excited to announce the launch of my new website, [url=https://jadonbarnes.com]jadonbarnes.com[/url]. The website is a hub for all of my projects, including assets and resource for other creators. One of which is the [url=https://jadonbarnes.com/blog/fwr-action-voice-library/]Fun with Ragdolls Action Voice Library[/url], which anyone can use for their own projects (or memes)!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/134027a6833d0e85a701be4b3858bc45091ff8cd.png[/img]

[h2]Stay Tuned for More Exciting Updates[/h2]
Thank you for your amazing support during the development of Fun with Ragdolls Plus. Be sure to bookmark [url=https://jadonbarnes.com]jadonbarnes.com[/url] and follow me on [url=https://twitter.com/ragdollguy]Twitter @RagdollGuy[/url], for updates and behind-the-scenes of the game's development. I appreciate your patience and understanding as we work tirelessly to make Fun with Ragdolls Plus the absolute best it can be.

Cheers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/0a862c7f236161867f36a8006239faa7803d91d2.gif[/img]

notes.title: Next for Fun with Ragdolls
notes.content:
It's been a long time. A lot has been happening in my personal life. Most notably, I'm a daddy now! So that's pretty cool. 😁

I'd like to apologize for lack of communication on my front. It's something I'd like to get much better at. I just didn't want to share anything unless it was noteworthy.

Well, I'd say this post is something noteworthy...

I'm excited to announce, after months of pre-production, careful planning, and heavy consideration, the 2nd Fun with Ragdolls game is on the way! An entirely new game is now in production!

I've been silent, but NOT oblivious to what many of you have been wanting and requesting from tweets, emails, comments, and strongly worded forum posts, lol. I've been taking notes on the major issues with the game. I want and need to address them in this second game.

I don't want to spoil anything, but I can assure you that the second game will be worthy of a new, separate game. For starters there will be:

[list]
[*] Weapons, including melee weapons!
[*] More vehicles! A tank included. :)
[*] Completely different gameplay style. While it will stay true to a 3rd person view, the way of playing/controlling the character will be altered and more intuitive.
[*] Dedicated in-game level editor that isn't combined with the character. This will open the door to more complex level design systems!
[*] Redesign of the world of Fun with Ragdolls, including the ragdoll model themselves.
[/list]

And one more thing...

I want to be completely honest, but at the same time, I don't want to give false hope. So when I say what I'm about to say, take it with a HEAVY grain of salt.

Local-multiplayer!

Yes, you heard me. You aren't the only ones that want it. As a friendly reminder, FWRTG was my first big game and it just kinda blew up. I've learned a lot since, including better programming patterns and practices. Technology has also improved since FWRTG.

I'm going to try my best to get local-multiplayer working smoothly and right. Even if it doesn't get implemented for whatever reason, I wanted to let you all know I am trying! And if it just crashes and burns, hopefully split-screen will suffice. 😉

As a friendly reminder, if I go quiet, it's not because I've given up or abandoned the game, it's because I'm working hard behind the scenes, just as I have been.

And of course, there are many other exciting big features I’m going to keep quite about for now that I KNOW you guys will love! I can’t spoil everything! Thank you all for your patience during everything. I hope you’re all as excited as I am! You can ask my wife just how stoked I am and she'll tell you, haha!

just a friendly reminder, game development is not a quick/easy process. This takes a LOT of time and effort.

To see the NEW ragdoll design and more updates, follow me on Twitter. I will continue to post there.

https://twitter.com/RagdollGuy

notes.title: 2.0 Released!
notes.content:
I've been working on 2.0 for too freaking long. But hey, it's here now! Here are some of the noteworthy features!

[h2]World Sharing[/h2]
That's right! You can upload and download worlds from within the game! Special thanks to mod.io for this to become a reality! Did I mention it's also cross-platform? No? Well, it's cross-platform! This means mobile and Steam players can upload and download worlds created from either platform!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/d9b7a786c1b27d4393c41e3cad49995fc5519e1d.png[/img]

[h2]Destructible Chain Reactions[/h2]
Ever wanted to see a structure you create collapse without floating blocks getting left behind! Destructible Chain Reactions (an option available in World Settings) allows neighbouring destructible items to set each other off!

Oh! I almost forgot! You can choose whether or not destroyed items disappear over time! This is disabled by default to save performance, but if you'd like to keep the leftover destruction, you can change this setting inside World Settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/a8d1cf42158944dfd08898ae062b05bf34eaabc0.gif[/img]

[h2]World Settings[/h2]
You can now adjust the settings of each world you create! Want to make your player's speed fast in one world and slow in another? Go for it! World Settings are saved for each world! This way, if you adjust your world's settings for a specific player experienced, it will be the same with others who download it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/60ed998945dc5300f1352b01ed29733d1de2edbf.png[/img]

[h2]Environments[/h2]
You can now change the skybox of your worlds to better set the tone of your creation!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/7b23faaf6d2f6d5ee07c578ce9fd5e7cb05489a0.gif[/img]

[h2]Item Properties[/h2]
In 1.0 items were provided to you as "variants". Essentially that meant every item has preset settings you couldn't change. Now with 2.0, every item in the game has properties you can adjust! You can also adjust the scale of any item in the game! This addition of properties makes it great for creators!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/e0c991cc98b116359f5cc2fcb2342d071b4061eb.png[/img]

[h2]Crouching[/h2]
It's... It's crouching. What else did you expect?

[h2]Bye Bye Progression System[/h2]
No more point system. It limits creativity for a game all about mindlessly throwing ragdolls around. You now get everything upfront so you can get to the fun part... Having fun with ragdolls! (I'm sorry, I had to say it.)

[h2]Optimizations & Ragdoll Performance[/h2]
The game was entirely rewritten with performance and longevity in mind! This means you can add many more items & ragdolls than you could before! The AI also saw an improvement with more pleasing collisions between Attacker and Defender Ragdolls

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/86cabb3713ceb4daf0c1a3e9154c3f4b451d9221.gif[/img]

[h2]Checkpoint Flag, Victory Flag, and Flags with Filters[/h2]
You can now use flags to set goals for ragdolls of a specific color! You can also set a checkpoint Flag and victory Flag for the player, which are great for mini-games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/557afee082d92fa0f810e747286947c06d54ce0a.gif[/img]

[h2]Advanced Stats[/h2]
See more details about how many items are in your world!

[h2]Real-time Loading[/h2]
While a hard ban on "loading" in general isn't possible since not everyone has a quantum computer yet, we're stuck with loading for now. That said, there are cooler ways to go about it. In this update, I figured loading screens were pretty boring, so I yeeted those things out of existence and replaced them with real-time loading! This is fancy marketing talk for watching the world load in front of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/78bbe88790f5661e7908cb0a6bfc472cad5f16b0.gif[/img]

[h2]New Free Cam & Cinematic Camera[/h2]
You can now build and explore using the new free camera, or create epic cinematic visuals using the Cinematic Camera Generator! With a single click of a button, the game will generate a new cinematic angle with automated dolly movements and focal lengths. It also attempts to ensure the player is always visible with each shot it generates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35765399/809263ce30eb4d3535e2590a30f9ef1fcff1c417.gif[/img]

[h2]And Much More (Really)[/h2]
Can't name everything here as it would flood your screen. I don't want to exhaust your scrolling finger before you get the chance to play the game!

If you'd like to see what else is new, you can view the [url=https://funwithragdolls.com/release-notes/200]release notes here[/url].

Thank you all so much for your support during this time of development, especially to my family & friends! Even if you've simply just watched a trailer and nothing more, thank you for taking the time to do so!

I really hope you all enjoy the game and have endless amounts of fun within it!

[url=https://www.funwithragdolls.com]https://www.funwithragdolls.com[/url]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & Improvements
notes.content:
I was watching some YouTubers play the game and I missed some really annoying bugs in the 1.4.0 release. Don't worry though, because this little update fixes those big annoyances!

[b]Changes[/b]
- Gravity adjustment strengths are stronger.
- Refined the jumping mechanic.
- Lowered jump height slightly.

[b]Fixes[/b]
- Mines & Black Holes now affect Cars.
- Cars go through Brick Walls more easily.
- Fixed misspelling of "Weak".
- Cars now have a max velocity instead of surpassing the speed of light.
- Gravity affects the player's jump and fall speeds more accurately.
- Shoot Player Canon works properly.

notes.content:

- Added Defender Spawner Flag
- Added Explorer Spawner Flag
- Added Player Goal Flag

- New icon

[b]Changed[/b]
- Set grey is the default ragdoll player skin
- Flying is snappier and more precise
- Ragdoll faces are slightly bigger
- Ragdolls don't make vocal sounds when dismembered
- Slow-motion when losing or winning is slower
- Player movement is more precise and less "floaty"

notes.title: 1.3.0 Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you so much for all the support. It's actually quite concerning how supportive you are. O_O

I've gotten quite a lot of feedback on the game. Like... a [b]lot[/b]. I've never created a game on​ this scale before, so I want to do it right! For the 1.3.0 update, I wanted to squash some bugs, tidy up experiences, and optimize things behind the scenes. Before I can add bigger and better things, I wanted to make sure I have a clean canvas to work with. So just hang tight!

Alright, that's enough chitter-chatter! Let's see what's inside!

[b]New[/b]
[list][*] Added iOS support
[*] Added Pistons
[*] Added Slow motion during Play Mode cheat
[*] Added Defender Ragdolls
[*] Added World Stats! See how many items you have in your scene.[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list][*] Ragdolls go into Ragdoll Mode when fracturing an object
[*] Ragdolls can now touch Dominos
[*] Ragdolls no longer avoid Levers
[*] Ragdolls can destroy pillars
[*] World save directory is created when the game first launches[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Ragdoll voice volume can actually be adjusted
[*] Performance improvement for Ragdolls
[*] Performance improvement for Menu System
[*] Performance improvement for Ragdoll Spawners
[*] Performance improvement for Build Items you place in the world
[*] Performance improvement for Destructible Objects
[*] Fixed bug where players lost their world saves when saving a new world
[*] Fixed issue where the resolution would automatically set after leaving the Settings menu[/list]
